keyEvents.text: Goal! Stuttgart 1, Werder Bremen 0. Maximilian Mittelstädt (Stuttgart) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Grischa Prömel.
Niclas Füllkrug (Werder Bremen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Luca Jaquez (Stuttgart).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) is shown the yellow card.
First Half ends, Stuttgart 1, Werder Bremen 0.
Marco Grüll (Werder Bremen) Yellow Card at 53'
